integrity: The proof uses exact Bloch-coordinate sums and an exact three-eigenvalue trace bound; the embedded standalone program supplies only finite floating-point cross-checks. Historical priority and external validation are not certified.
scientific_limitations: All group elements, including repeated projectors, are counted; unit spinor normalization and the two-dimensional irreducible dihedral representation are assumed. The result concerns stable Hermitian matrix recovery, not nonlinear noise robustness. A broad 2025 finite-group phase-retrieval paper was not verified in full text, retaining a specific literature-priority risk. Numerical tests cover a bounded range only.
title: Optimal operator-frame conditioning for all two-dimensional dihedral irreducibles
